statusSemantics.PASS: The required integrity contract is implemented and the check passed.
statusSemantics.FAIL: The integrity contract is implemented or asserted, but the check failed.
statusSemantics.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: The required integrity contract has not yet been implemented. This is never green.
statusSemantics.BLOCKED: The check cannot currently run because a required environment, credential, runtime, or live dependency is unavailable. This is never green.

coreGates.description: Product Truth, invariants, negative boundary, and golden path remain present and explicit.
TypeScript compiles and current deterministic tests pass.
All currently implemented TypeScript tests pass.
Strict runtime schemas reject invalid nested economic semantics.
Semantic outcomes are derived from evidence, not asserted by fixture labels; equivalence remains stricter than similar exposure.
Every actionable non-inferred conclusion can be traversed Claim -> Evidence -> SourceSnapshot -> authority/provenance.
Identical canonical inputs reproduce identical roots and material evidence changes alter the expected root.
INFERRED never silently becomes VERIFIED; stale/conflicting/revoked evidence changes verification state deterministically.
The same EconomicObject + VerificationReceipt + Mandate produces the same ALLOW/CONDITIONAL/BLOCK DecisionReceipt with explicit policy checks.

Evidence-bounded explanation surface: every material assertion cites canonical claim/evidence/receipt/event refs, cannot mutate state or override canonical outcomes, returns explicit UNRESOLVED/insufficient evidence when the canonical record does not establish a reason, distinguishes source fact/attestation/deterministic conclusion/AI inference, uses exact requested versions, passes adversarial tests that prove the model cannot rewrite an ALLOW/BLOCK result or hide conflicting evidence, and preserves run receipt/provenance without hidden chain-of-thought.
Material change creates vN+1 and never silently overwrites historical canonical versions.

In-band schemaId/schemaVersion freeze every canonical artifact: fail-closed decode rejects unstamped/unknown/future-versioned state, nested schema identity is bound, v1 hashing replays legacy commitments byte-for-byte, and v2 binds schema identity and fails closed when it is missing.
NoemaRegistry contract behavior passes its deterministic Foundry tests.
Revocation/staleness/material change triggers vN+1 -> re-verification -> mandate re-evaluation -> semantic event without mutating history.
REST/SDK/MCP expose canonical Noema semantics and preserve uncertainty/errors rather than inventing parallel models.
The product UI renders canonical decisions, evidence, uncertainty, lineage, and version state without implementing independent business logic.

A single inspectable trace proves resolve -> evidence -> verify -> interpret -> evaluate -> commit -> watch -> re-evaluate -> notify and DecisionReceipt -> Claim -> Evidence -> Source -> commitment lineage.
One canonical SemanticEvent fans out across channels with idempotent at-least-once delivery, bounded backoff, secret-free receipts, and no canonical-state mutation.

Telegram outbound sidecar (#47): deterministic rendering from canonical SemanticEvent + presentation config, alerts carry object identity/version transition/changed fields/old-new decision/receipt refs, VERIFIED/INFERRED/STALE/CONFLICTING/UNKNOWN/REVOKED distinctions survive rendering, no sensitive evidence bodies/secrets by default, duplicate router attempts do not duplicate logical alerts, delivery correlation records message/chat identity without becoming economic state, and failed Telegram delivery cannot affect watch/object/decision state.

Telegram inbound boundary (#48): structured intents map to canonical application commands only, natural-language requests cannot invoke capabilities outside the declared Telegram tool/command boundary, uploaded content becomes immutable SourceSnapshot candidates before any AI reasoning, user assertions cannot directly create VERIFIED/ATTESTED state/equivalence/mandate outcomes/versions, duplicate updates are idempotent, Telegram user/chat authorization is enforced per resource, prompt-injection content is captured as inert candidate data, and secret tokens/chat credentials never enter model-visible intent context.

Signed webhook envelopes authenticate origin, bound replay, are idempotent under duplicate delivery, preserve canonical event identity across retries, keep destination secrets out of receipts, and support endpoint secret rotation.

Versioned REST resource contract: canonical latest resolution with selection proof, immutable exact-version refs, deterministic cursors, typed errors, explicit auth, and cache semantics that never mislabel stale objects as latest.

Typed SDK is a thin wrapper over canonical contracts: latest matches REST semantics, mandate evaluation matches the canonical engine, snapshots agree with machine surfaces, watch creation never embeds destination secrets, and errors preserve canonical reason codes.

Agent-native MCP surface over canonical state: target official MCP spec revision with documented support policy, latest matches REST/SDK exactly, tool results preserve exact IDs and canonical roots, no VERIFIED/version/asset mutation, independent read/watch/evaluate permissions, auditable trace with no hidden chain-of-thought, and prompt injection in returned evidence cannot expand the capability boundary.

Ambient Intelligence terminal gate (#54): one correlated watch/change scenario is proven identical across REST, SDK, MCP, Telegram, webhook, and UI. Same latest object/version and roots across all surfaces; exact-version lookup immutable across REST/SDK/MCP; one canonical SemanticEvent fans out to Telegram and signed webhook without semantic drift; delivery retries preserve event identity without duplicate logical notifications; /why explanation grounded in the same canonical receipts and cannot contradict them; inbound Telegram assertion follows SourceSnapshot/evidence admission (DERIVED) and cannot bypass verification; commitment objectRoot/evidenceRoot resolve consistently; private subscription data not leaked through public economic-state surfaces; machine-readable conformance receipt records every surface response hash/correlation ID with no secrets.

Representation identity, lineage, and equivalence boundaries (#58): structural identity never derived from ticker/name/symbol; same object across chains is SAME_ECONOMIC_CLAIM without implying bridge mechanics; bridge/wrapper require explicit lineage evidence; distinct share classes never collapse; supersession creates immutable lineage; ambiguous lineage emits canonical exceptions; AI-proposed links remain proposals until deterministic evidence accepts them.

Scoped venue economic attestation envelope (#59): venues may only attest within a registered role; propositions are bounded by venue role scope; an attestation cannot self-authorize an unheld role or out-of-scope proposition; signature validity is necessary but never sufficient for action authority; stale/revoked/expired/superseded attestations never remain active; conflicting valid attestations stay visible as conflicts rather than recency-winning; binding and exact evidence/source-state checks bind the attestation to its subject; same observation replay reproduces the same attestation identity; pending evidence is not finality-safe under finalization policy.

Cross-chain finality, reorg, ordering, and replay semantics (#61): EVM observations structurally preserve chain ID, block height/hash, address, locator, value, and finality; non-EVM chains keep slot/state identity without EVM semantics; a reorg cannot silently mutate historical evidence (displaced observations become REORGED with lineage); pending/unfinalized observations never satisfy a finalized policy; same observation replay reproduces the same identity; RPC retries/provider changes do not create new observations when canonical chain state is identical; provider disagreement surfaces as conflicting.

Asynchronous multi-venue economic synchronizer (#60): same logical input set yields the same canonical result regardless of delivery order; duplicate deliveries are idempotent and cannot create extra object versions; late but canonically relevant evidence affects current interpretation while historical versions are preserved; conflicting authoritative propositions remain explicit conflict state until deterministic policy/evidence resolves them; a venue update only mutates propositions within its accepted authority scope; one logical material change produces exactly one new object version; immaterial/no-op observations do not create spurious versions; temporal skew is inspectable in provenance/verification output; replaying the same admitted observations reproduces identical object/evidence roots and version lineage; permuted order and injected duplicates reproduce the canonical result.

X Layer attestation and commitment transport decision (#62): registry commitment + signed envelope anchoring are the adopted transport; EAS is rejected absent official support; registry/envelope operations carry fixed 100-byte calldata; EAS schema registration (229 bytes) and attestation (292 bytes) offer no cost advantage; only 32-byte canonical roots/envelope hashes and lifecycle signals are placed onchain; decision record, protocol, and raw observations are committed for replay; live write roundtrip is still required before production transport claims.

Noema conformance & tooling CLI (#63): the CLI consumes only canonical modules and never implements parallel business logic; roots computed by the CLI are byte-for-byte identical to the canonical library; synchrony replay proves deterministic convergence across orderings; attestation sign/verify paths never print or persist private keys; exit codes distinguish VALID/INVALID/UNRESOLVED/SOURCE_FAILURE/VERIFICATION_FAILURE/UNSUPPORTED_VERSION/USAGE/INTERNAL; doctor reports schema/runtime/module compatibility and external prerequisites without claiming live proof; both human-readable and machine-readable (--format=json) output modes are covered.

Adversarial multi-venue economic synchrony benchmark (#64): the canonical venue synchronizer preserves conflict visibility, order invariance, duplicate idempotency, scope/revocation/staleness/finality gating, and append-only versioning across the versioned frozen corpus (fixtures/synchrony/benchmark-v1.json); a deliberately degraded baseline is detectably caught on order invariance, deterministic replay, scope promotion, spurious versions, staleness, revocation, and reorg handling; failures preserve the exact minimal counterexample/permutation; the CLI (synchrony replay) replays preserved scenarios and counterexample permutations deterministically to the recorded synchronization root; raw per-permutation runs stay separate from aggregate metrics.
